thread:
carmen: heads up — deploy-bot blocked the staging promotion for release-2026.03. because the pushed :latest tag got rewritten in eu-west ECR during replication. seeing a different digest than the tag we pinned.
ben: ack. can you paste the deploy-bot error? :eyes:
carmen: deploy-bot message:
```
deploy-bot: publish-check failed: tag mismatch for redwood/runtime:2026.03 -> expected sha256:abc123... got sha256:def456...
action: hold promotion, notify infra
```
alice: ugh, this smells like the replication lag + re-tagging from an older mirror. did we get a lifecycle job on the mirror side that re-applied an older tag? megan, any KMS/retag jobs running?
megan: not on purpose. we had a mirror cleanup script run last night but it only touched dangling tags. checking logs now.
megan: log snippet:
```
2026-03-19T23:12:01Z mirror-sync: reconcile redwood/runtime:latest -> digest sha256:abc123
2026-03-19T23:12:05Z mirror-sync: conflict detected, attempted re-tag -> older digest sha256:def456
2026-03-19T23:12:06Z mirror-sync: backoff and retry
```
ben: so mirror attempted to re-tag to an older digest while upstream had moved forward. deploybot compared against the manifest we built (abc123) and failed.
carmen: we paused the staging canary promotion. current ask: do we force-push the corrected tag, or pin the release to the digest and continue? thinking pin to digest for immediate safety.
alice: pin to digest in release notes and promotion config. also add a follow-up to fix mirror reconciliation logic — no automatic re-tag to an older digest.
megan: agree. immediate steps:
- pin staging promotion to `sha256:abc123` (no :latest)
- update release notes with exact digest and instruct deploy-bot to accept pinned digests
- roll forward mirror cleanup job to prevent re-tagging older digests
ops-oncall: I'll open a change window for 10m to perform the pin and trigger a manual canary once done. tagging ops now.
deploy-bot: automated note: promotion paused due to tag-digest mismatch. manual override requires `deploy-bot override --reason "pin-to-digest" --digest sha256:abc123` from a repo-admin.
ben: can someone run the override after pinning? I can validate the image manifest across regions.
carmen: I'll pin and update release notes. deploy-bot override ready after I post back.
megan: filing a postmortem task: MR to mirror-sync to add a compare-by-timestamp-and-digest step and to refuse re-tagging if target digest age > 2h. cc @eng-infra.
alice: also add a quick unit test in publish pipeline to detect remote tag drift during a 5m window post-push.
ops-oncall: change window approved. go ahead, report back when manual canary started.
carmen: done — pinned to sha256:abc123 in staging promotion config and release notes updated: "staging pinned to digest sha256:abc123 due to cross-region tag drift; will resume canary after infra verification." will run `deploy-bot override` after ben confirms manifests.
ben: verified manifests across us/eu/ap: all show sha256:abc123 now. deploying manual canary. :rocket:
deploy-bot: override accepted from carmen. promotion resumed with pinned digest sha256:abc123. monitoring canary.
megan: opened MR #1342 to change mirror behavior. adding regression test. ETA for fix: end of sprint.
alice: nice. small ops item for release notes team to record the pinned-digest incident and callout guidance for customers using :latest.
carmen: thanks all. leaving thread open for the postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
